title: Void Eater spiral drain sweep on decoded media

metricComparisons.description: Spiral drain with high trail should differ from source — advected dye displaces pixels, changing the luma distribution

expectedVideo: pixels should visibly spiral toward the centre as the fluid velocity builds up over several frames
large pixel blocks (pixelSize >= 12) should be clearly visible as distinct chunks advecting through the field
reversing twirl sign should flip the spiral direction without popping
expectedAudio: the loaded clip audio should stay present while the spiral fluid effect builds
manualChecks: Do the pixel blocks read as large chunky quanta swirling into a drain, or just blurred motion?
Does increasing pixelSize from 4 to 32 visibly coarsen the block size in proportion?
Does sink > 0 add a noticeable inward collapse component on top of the rotation?
